decisions.rationale: Final three rows, under the same claimed/practised rule. (1) Pydantic: narrow the claim to 'splits rows into accepted and rejected', which its check and named test observe; catching ValidationError and recording error details become practised, owned by the topic page. (2) Upsert: narrow the claim to 'a repeated load leaves no duplicate rows'; writing INSERT ... ON CONFLICT ... DO UPDATE and keying on the unique constraint become practised and partial, owned by the topic. (3) Prompt minimization: change the existing pre-application check so the learner predicts the projected output record (which fields remain) rather than only naming sensitive fields, matching the claim and the public test that observes dropping. No time, syllabus or container change.
Closed by the Pydantic narrowing in python-intake-edu-recheck-001 (1); the upsert row stays partial as already recorded.
